title: [eBay Plus] Sunlu Filament 5kg from $44.78 Delivered ($8.96/Roll) @ sunlo_3d_direct eBay
body:
Deal: [eBay Plus] Sunlu Filament 5kg from $44.78 Delivered ($8.96/Roll) @ sunlo_3d_direct eBay

[Booshbosch] Wow that’s cheap, but I don’t need more!
[tanabe88gg] Hell yeah I'll take some orange for <$9 thanks!
[badmonkeh] Nice thanks OP.
Don’t forget Forrest Green Marble HS PLA, even cheaper :P
[sebasg91] Thanks OP! Grabbed 5. You can use TAX15 if you don't have eBay plus.
[Water Bearer] Had no idea what in the fudge this even was. First it looked like sewing string lol. Then i figured filament was some sort of ink. After a couple weeks of thinking it over i came to the conclusion its for 3d printers lol.
[callumbolch] Given I print FDM terrain for tabletop wargames and prime/paint everything the orange at $9/kg will do nicely.
[RichardZed] Don't post to where I live :( 0ne hour flight out of Melbourne.
[sammy61187] Great deal but I've had the worse luck with Sunlu so many breakages
[b0nd] Any recommendation on 3D printer? Before I buy this 😅
[Quarn] I'm not a fan but Bambu printers are the iPhones of 3D. If you are more technical or willing to play and learn then there are lots of options, core XY are faster and better than bed slingers. Creality K1C is less than $500 for example.
[Pete Gabitas] A1 with AMS Lite is a good solid starting point.
[SoTightEcoLPI] Is $86 about right without eBay plus that's 5 delivered and Pla+
Thanks
[SoTightEcoLPI] Yeah I did with pla+, pla runs bad on mine.
Ordered 5 pla+ for $86. Thanks op.
[lilviss] :(
As per description
There are problems with some of your items.
To complete your order, go to checkout and update your delivery address or ask the seller if they can post to your location.
[r0xz] Only limited colours. Too many pokemons…
